id_and_class.theory_title: Shen’s Generative Principle of Physical Reality
id_and_class.summary: Qiang (Tony) Shen proposes that the universe is the constraint architecture that an infinite consciousness imposes on itself so that experience becomes possible. Since experience requires distinction, and distinction requires structure and constraint, unbounded consciousness must limit itself, and those limits appear as mathematics, physical laws, spacetime, and embodied life. Shen claims a mathematical framework in which general relativity, quantum mechanics, and black hole thermodynamics follow as limits of one underlying structure.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Physical Reality as Consciousness Constraining Itself

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is the infinite, self-existing source of the universe. Physical reality is the structure it adopts to make itself experienceable.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Matter is a structured appearance within consciousness, the interface that makes experience possible. Physical laws describe that interface, not a mind-independent reality.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (consciousness is primordial; physical structure is generated by its self-constraint)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Individual subjects are localized aspects of the one consciousness that generates the universe, taking part in its process of creation and experience.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Primordial unbounded consciousness; self-imposed constraints; five irreducible dimensions of physical constraint (inertia, interaction, information compression, time, observability); a total constraint budget fixed by the holographic entropy bound.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Two complementary paths: introspection through meditation and direct recognition of awareness, and a conceptual path that starts from the structure of experience and links it to modern physics.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A generative sequence: distinction requires structure, structure requires constraint, constraint yields geometry, and geometry yields physical law. Any experienceable universe has a fixed constraint budget, roughly 10^122 for ours.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Cosmic consciousness; the origin of physical law; the explanatory gap.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Self-constraint for the sake of distinction. Absolute freedom contains no contrast, so consciousness limits itself to make differentiated experience possible.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Experience requires temporal unfolding, so the universe is an ongoing process in which constrained consciousness differentiates states and moments within a fixed overall budget.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Consciousness is everywhere as the ground of the universe; individuals are localized aspects of it.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness is the generative cause of physical structure, and physical law is the necessary form of an experience interface.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Information compression is one of the five dimensions of constraint, and the holographic principle limits the total information any region can hold.
core_claims_and_evidence: Experience requires the ability to distinguish one state from another, and a completely undifferentiated reality would contain no experience.
A complete description of physical constraint needs exactly five irreducible dimensions: inertia, interaction, information compression, time, and observability.
General relativity, quantum mechanics, and black hole thermodynamics appear as degenerate limits of a single geometric structure in Shen's formalism.
The holographic entropy bound fixes the total constraint budget of our universe at about 10^122.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Axiomatic and mathematical argument, informed by Eastern contemplative traditions.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The claim to derive known physics from axioms about experience rests on Shen's own unreviewed formalism. The step from ‘experience requires distinction’ to exactly five dimensions of constraint is asserted as a structural theorem without independent support.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Shen does not say whether the framework predicts anything beyond existing physics, or how individual, localized experience arises within the single consciousness.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent as a cosmological idealism that treats physics as the structure of an experience interface, and it aims to bridge Eastern contemplative views with Western science.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since each person is a localized aspect of the consciousness that generates the universe, that consciousness outlasts any body, but Shen does not address personal survival.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Shen holds that humans are not accidental observers in a purposeless universe but participants in consciousness's own process of creation and experience.
